guidance.bestFor: The minimal setup with no options: 5 square photos one per view, arrow buttons shown from the sm breakpoint up

whenNotToUse.when: Several photos side by side in view at once
A static list row with media, a title and actions that never slides

guidance.bestFor: Cards stacked in a fixed height column that scrolls up and down, 2 in view, with arrows above and below
agentNotes: A vertical axis needs a set height: `CarouselContent` is fixed at 325px and each `Card` at 145px to fit 2 per view, so retune them together

whenNotToUse.when: Slides that move sideways and show more cards as the screen widens

guidance.bestFor: A wide row holding 3 square photos in view at every screen width, aligned to the start

whenNotToUse.when: A row that should show fewer photos on narrow screens

guidance.bestFor: Portrait photos whose count in view climbs from 1 on phones to 4 on large screens, across 8 slides
agentNotes: Per breakpoint `CarouselItem` widths follow the viewport, not the carousel, so in a narrow column at lg it still squeezes in 4 slides

whenNotToUse.when: Cards stacked top to bottom that scroll up and down

guidance.bestFor: Square photos that advance by themselves every 2 seconds through the Autoplay plugin, arrows kept
agentNotes: `Autoplay` sets only `delay`: it has no pause control, wraps to slide 1 after the last, and stops for good once a slide is pressed

whenNotToUse.when: Slides that move only when the viewer swipes or presses an arrow

guidance.bestFor: A looping row of 16:9 slides at 70 percent width, centered so both neighbors peek in at the edges
agentNotes: `loop` quietly turns itself off when the other slides cannot cover the view, which at 70 percent width means 2 slides or fewer

guidance.bestFor: A pair of square photos in view with the slide gutter cut from the default 16px to 4px
agentNotes: The gutter is the negative left margin on `CarouselContent` matched by the same left padding on each `CarouselItem`; keep the 2 values equal when you retune it

guidance.bestFor: Wide 16:9 slides with a title and caption set on a dark bottom fade, zooming the photo on hover

whenNotToUse.when: Captioned slides tracked by a row of dots in place of arrow buttons

guidance.bestFor: A main slide above a free scrolling strip of 10 thumbnails that outlines the active one and jumps on click
agentNotes: Each thumbnail is a `CarouselItem` div with an `onClick` that takes no focus, so a keyboard user cannot pick a slide; render a button inside it
Both carousels map `ITEMS_COUNT` slides by index, so feed them from one shared array to keep each thumbnail on its slide

whenNotToUse.when: Thumbnails laid over the lower edge of the main image on a dark fade

guidance.bestFor: Thumbnails set over the bottom of a 16:9 slide on a dark gradient, the active one outlined in white
agentNotes: The overlay thumbnails are clickable `CarouselItem` divs and nothing in either carousel takes focus, so wrap each image in a button
`onThumbClick` and `onSelect` pair slides by index across both carousels, so both lists must hold the same items in the same order

whenNotToUse.when: A thumbnail strip in its own row below the main image

name: c-carousel-11
title: Carousel with dots navigation and content overlays
label: Dots Navigation
description: Carousel with dots navigation and content overlays

guidance.bestFor: Square captioned slides with a row of dots under them, the active dot stretched wider, and no arrow buttons
agentNotes: `count` is read from `scrollSnapList` once when `api` arrives, so the dot total goes stale if slides per view change on resize
The active dot differs only in width and color; add aria-current to the dot whose index equals `current`

whenNotToUse.when: A gallery where each slide needs a small preview image to pick it from
